units.passage: Human-Subject Research Data: For use cases involving human-subject research data, contact the Institutional Review Board ( irbinfo@uwm.edu ), information security office ( infosec@uwm.edu ) and research computing team ( research-computing@uwm.edu ) to review your use case.
units.why: Human-subject research data requires contacting "the Institutional Review Board" plus security and research computing; research-data rule, P62.
